title: A harvest at risk
description: War has disrupted the systems that turn land into a harvest: fuel for the pump, cash for seed and labour, a safe road to market and a buyer at the end of it. Recovery means reconnecting them.
quote: What farmers lack is not the will but the means.
metricLabel: fall in cereal production in the first year of war

title: Water: switching on the season
description: Solar pumps break the dependence on expensive diesel. Rehabilitated canals return idle land to production. Reliable water is the foundation, but it is only the beginning.
quote: The solar irrigation system has reduced production costs, expanded cultivated areas, encouraged crop diversification, and increased income for many members of our association.
attribution: Ahmed Abdalla, Hassad Alamal Association, Berber
metricLabel: solar-powered irrigation interventions across five states

title: Inputs: more land, better crops
description: Seed, tools, tractors and extension support help farmers put more land to work. 15,000 farmers received 120 tonnes of seed and tools; 15,000 were trained through 600 field schools. These groups may overlap.
quote: This harvest gives me hope. With the right support, farmers can improve their lives and contribute to feeding their communities.

title: Access to finance and investment
description: Working capital pays for labour, seed, transport and a full season. The Credit Guarantee Scheme with Al-Ibdaa Bank financed 122 farmers in three states. Every instalment due by mid-November 2026 was paid on time.
quote: A 100 per cent repayment rate is the farmers' own testimony.
metricLabel: of instalments due paid on time; not fully repaid loans

title: Markets: from harvest to income
description: Storage, aggregation, women-led markets and links to buyers keep value in farming communities. Solar-powered cold storage and lighting help women trade for longer and reduce losses.
quote: The financing transformed my business from a small workshop struggling to survive into a growing enterprise.
attribution: Sitna Abdel Rahim Abdel Majeed, entrepreneur, Kosti
metricLabel: stalls in a refurbished women-led River Nile market

title: What it adds up to
description: Water plus inputs plus capital plus a market: together, they make a harvest that feeds a family and pays its way. The gains are visible in restored land, lower fuel costs, higher incomes and the prospect of more jobs.
quote: When farmers have water, inputs, finance and markets, they grow their way to recovery.
metricLabel: jobs on financed farms: current to expected within six months
